ROOT CAUSE: plants have no carrying capacity — lifecycle.ts:73 divides any PHOTO w/ energy>=threshold, zero density check → exponential growth to ~90% packing (permanent overlap = the jiggle). Break-even light L=0.3 (basal 0.54 / photoGain*area 1.8).

372 = maxBonds(4096)/11 bonds-per-forager EXACTLY (forager=6 cells,11 bonds,2 syn). Buffer ceiling, not ecology.
